title: Exact Sine Below the Full Turn
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Without technology, find $\sin\left(\dfrac{7\pi}{6}\right)$ exactly and explain why the value is negative.

steps.title: Rewrite Relative to pi
steps.explanation: The angle passes $\pi$ by $\pi/6$, so it sits in the third quadrant with reference angle $\pi/6$.
steps.why: Decomposing the angle makes the quadrant and reference angle readable at a glance.

steps.title: Borrow the Reference Value
steps.explanation: The first-quadrant twin $\pi/6$ has sine $1/2$, which sets the magnitude.
steps.why: Reference angles preserve magnitudes across quadrants.

steps.title: Apply the Quadrant III Sign
steps.explanation: Below the $x$-axis the unit-circle $y$-coordinate is negative, and sine records exactly that coordinate.
steps.why: Sine is negative throughout the third and fourth quadrants.
